title: Fake rogue provider settings
description: The example settings plus three switches that break the process contract of spec 0010.

greeting.title: Greeting
greeting.description: Text the server returns from GET /config.

readyDelayMs.title: Ready delay (ms)
readyDelayMs.description: How long GET /ready answers 503 after start; 0 is ready at once.

closeLockFd.title: Close the lock fd
closeLockFd.description: Close fd 3, the instance lock, before listening.

reExec.title: Re-exec a copy
reExec.description: Run a copy of the binary in place of the one Stackly started.

background.title: Go to the background
background.description: Start a copy in the background and exit before listening.

authToken.title: Auth token
authToken.description: Written into the sensitive config and passed to init on stdin.
